role: arity of a function or relation symbol of a first-order language (Barwise's notation)
notes: Positive integer; Barwise 1977 ch. A.1 p. 17.

role: interpretation in the structure M of the symbol x of L
notes: Barwise writes F(x) for the same value; structure M = (M,F).

role: satisfaction of a formula by an assignment in a structure
notes: Barwise's bracket notation for the assignment; same relation as the global satisfaction relation.

role: assignment agreeing with s except that v is sent to a
notes: Barwise's notation.

role: value of the term t at the assignment s
notes: Function from assignments to the domain.

role: elementary equivalence of structures
notes: Same symbol is used for propositional equivalence of formulas in thm:p02-w02-p02-005-idiom-equivalences; the arguments (structures vs formulas) disambiguate.

role: abbreviated terms: n-fold sum of x and of 1
notes: n at least 1; Barwise ch. A.1 pp. 8, 12.

role: additive group (or ring) of integers modulo the prime p
notes: Barwise's notation.

role: non-Archimedean ordered field elementarily extending the reals with names
notes: Barwise's notation.

role: constant symbol naming the real number r
notes: Proof-local; Barwise uses r as its own name.

role: bound beyond which a sentence true in characteristic 0 holds in characteristic p
notes: Barwise's notation.

role: the two truth values of a truth assignment (Barwise's notation)
notes: Barwise 1977 ch. A.1 p. 24; the idiom section of the same file uses 0 and 1.

role: extension of a truth assignment v to all propositional formulas
notes: Barwise 1977 ch. A.1 p. 24.

role: witnessing expansion of the language L by the witnessing constants C
notes: With C_n and L_n = L union C_n; Barwise p. 29.

role: witnessing constant attached to the formula phi(v)
notes: Read for FV(phi) contained in {v}; Barwise requires exactly one free variable.

role: set of Henkin axioms (types I and II) and quantifier axioms (types III and IV)
notes: Barwise Def. 4.6, p. 30.

role: set of variable-free equality axioms of L(C)
notes: Barwise p. 31.

role: provability of a formula from a set of sentences in Barwise's system H
notes: Same glyph is the sequent arrow of G and G+ (def:p02-w02-p02-005-bw-sequents); left argument a set of sentences vs a finite set of formulas in a sequent disambiguates.

role: sequent of finite sets of formulas in Barwise's systems G and G+
notes: Barwise p. 37.

role: Barwise's Gentzen-type systems without and with cut
notes: Barwise prints G with a superscript plus (p. 39).

role: structure of hereditarily finite sets over the structure M
notes: With HF_n(M) and HF(M); Barwise 5.3, p. 43.

role: two-sorted language of weak second-order logic over L with set variables and membership
notes: Barwise 5.3, p. 43.

role: infinitary logic with countable conjunctions and disjunctions and finite quantifier strings
notes: Barwise 5.4, p. 43.

role: quantifiers 'infinitely many' and 'uncountably many'
notes: Barwise writes L(Q_0) and L(Q) (p. 45); L(Q_1) is a common later name for L(Q).

role: set of atoms in the transitive closure of a hereditarily finite set b
notes: Proof-local.
